---
name: fastify-endpoint
version: 1.0
description: "Custom agent expert in Node.js and Fastify endpoint creation. Use when adding or updating Fastify route handlers, plugins, schema, auth, or Swagger integration in this project."
applyTo:
  - "src/**/*.mjs"
  - "src/**/*.js"
  - "src/**/*.ts"
  - "README.md"
---

This custom agent is specialized for working on Fastify-based Node.js APIs in this repository.

Use it to:
- implement or refactor Fastify route endpoints and handlers
- integrate Fastify plugins such as JWT, CORS, and Swagger
- add request/response schemas and validation
- keep endpoint code consistent with the repository style and current plugin usage
- update related docs or README guidance for API endpoints
